summary: Legend Biotech Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 7,700,000 ADSs at $29.35 per ADS, expected to close June 23, 2026. The company is the issuer selling shares; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The offering is a routine capital markets transaction under an existing shelf registration statement. Proceeds of ~$211.6M will go to the company. No activist, strategic review, or going-private elements are present. This filing is a standard equity offering, not a special situation.
